verdict.rationale: Superpowers keeps a first-party RELEASE-NOTES.md at the repo root with detailed, skill-level change descriptions, so a developer can see what changed before updating. Examples include worktree removal no longer destroying untracked files, the plan-scoped sdd-workspace, the review-fix loop resuming the implementer, the TDD reference doc renamed to writing-good-tests.md, and new harness support for Devin CLI, Hermes and Grok. missing for 10: evidence that entries are tied to explicit version numbers or dates, a link between the notes and the marketplace/plugin update flow, and independent corroboration that users rely on these notes before updating.
